slides.title: Investify
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the team and supervisor. The preparation date is not a confirmed assessment date. The project is an educational prototype. It does not execute orders or establish investment suitability. Working implementation, diagrams and assessment drafts include assistant contributions. Genuine student review and ownership evidence remain pending. Sources: planning/CHECKPOINT.md and report/main.tex. Timing: 30 seconds.

slides.title: Problem and research contribution
slides.speaker_notes: FinBERT provides news sentiment, XGBoost classifies the feature vector, and TreeSHAP supplies model attributions. Explain the engineering contribution without claiming invention of these methods or established research novelty. An explanation can be numerically consistent without being useful or causal. The related-work chapter compares the research components and discusses the remaining novelty review. Research sources in that chapter include FinBERT arXiv:1908.10063 and TreeSHAP arXiv:1802.03888. Timing: 60 seconds.

slides.title: Scope and acceptance checks
slides.speaker_notes: The four record collections preserve historical and fresh frozen/refit identities. There are 186 decisions in each evaluation collection, not independent experiments to sum as a single sample. The risk-dependent blend is a separate retrospective prototype and does not modify the classifier probabilities. No default questionnaire responses are supplied. Social inputs have not been integrated into the news-only core. Original Phi-3-mini inference and QLoRA training remain unmeasured. Timing: 60 seconds.

slides.title: System architecture

The optional local generation adapter is implemented but candidate student performance remains pending. The separate social study has its own inputs and labels. Timing: 70 seconds.

slides.title: Explanation check and recovery
slides.speaker_notes: An earlier verifier accepted facts from the payload even when the visible sentence contradicted them. The current verifier checks both independently. In the live demo, inject the labelled wrong probability of 1.00 percent. Explain that this deliberately corrupted text is a failure demonstration, not a forecast. The report sequence and state diagrams show rejection, fallback and invalidation after edits. Numerical consistency does not establish causal validity or human comprehension. Timing: 60 seconds.

slides.title: Calibration and decision collapse
slides.speaker_notes: These are fresh Alpaca revision-conservative results, not overwritten September metrics. The frozen and refit paths both reproduce actual model, calibration and native SHAP results. After excluding five unavailable labels, calibration has 181 rows. Frozen raw macro-F1 is 0.3182 and calibrated macro-F1 is 0.2238. Refit Brier changes from 0.7760 to 0.6078. The class-prior comparator uses calibration labels only, with Brier 0.60948945. Do not tune thresholds on this evaluation set to manufacture varied decisions. Timing: 60 seconds.

slides.title: Temporal leakage experiment
slides.speaker_notes: The fresh study executes six arms, two horizons and six folds. The centered Bollinger variant deliberately uses future information and is a leakage demonstration. Its five-session lift is plus 0.2104, with fold-bootstrap interval plus 0.1698 to plus 0.2421. It is not a valid trading strategy. The clean arm is below the training-distribution random comparator. The intervals summarize fold resampling, not guaranteed future returns. Preserve the negative finding. The source vintage and full chronological September reproduction remain separate limitations. Timing: 60 seconds.

slides.title: Sentiment and teacher studies
slides.speaker_notes: Both original publisher sentiment candidates run against unchanged AI references. CryptoBERT predicts only neutral. The 200 acquired MSFT posts yielded 117 usable references and 83 exclusions, frozen into 93 development and 24 held-out examples. These labels are not independently human validated. One held-out decision changes exact agreement by 4.17 percentage points. Do not infer NVDA transfer, profitability, significance or pretraining independence. The teacher prose is actual assistant output with deterministic factual JSON assembled from records. The exact serving revision is unavailable. Six examples do not establish adequate training data, student efficacy or user benefit. Timing: 60 seconds.
